active_requirements.title: Employee Authentication & Role-Based Access Control
active_requirements.description: Add employee authentication with JWT tokens and role-based access control (admin vs user).
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Users can authenticate with email and password to receive a valid JWT token
AC-2: Protected endpoints reject requests with missing or invalid tokens (401)
AC-3: Admin-only routes return 403 Forbidden when accessed by non-admin users
AC-4: Audit log records successful and failed login attempts
